name: Oono Jirou
source: friend of protagonist that is very popular with women. Despite being into himself claims that he has a very low bar when it comes to women that weighing 200 kg, smelling bad or even being shemale doesn't bother him. But has 0 tolerance for people that would make fun of his friends. Is also not good with women that are stronger than him. Due to relative telling him about dating yankee girl and having bad exp.
